title: Content items that share only a union-merged ledger such as _anchors.csv run in parallel, as items sharing only a kb/_self doc do
goal: SP-tjap3mdd retrospective: the public root's _anchors.csv sat in the touches of 8 of 9 items, so start warned and depends_on chained them, and the sprint ran in seven serial rounds although each item edited a different article and .gitattributes merges _anchors.csv with merge=union (kbgit.py fix dedups it). bl_plan's overlap rule (shared_doc and its callers in _tools/bl_plan.py) treats a path .gitattributes merges with merge=union like a kb/_self doc: no overlap for held --overlaps, check or start, while the landing's rebase and the stale, eval and lint steps still run per item.

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_plan as p
led = 'kb/public/_anchors.csv'
assert p.shared_doc(led), 'union ledger is no shared doc'
assert p.shared_doc('kb/public/_gaps.md')
assert not p.touches_meet(led, led, [led]), 'union ledger meets itself'
assert not p.touches_meet('kb/public/*.csv', led, [led]), 'glob meets ledger'
assert not p.shared_doc('kb/public/articles/x.md') and not p.shared_doc('_tools/bl_plan.py')
assert p.touches_meet('_tools/bl_plan.py', '_tools/bl_plan.py', ['_tools/bl_plan.py'])
class BL:
    def __init__(s):
        s.items = dict(('ST-' + n, dict(touches=[led, 'kb/public/a' + n + '.md'], status='draft')) for n in 'abcd')
bl = BL()
found, n = p.shared_files(bl, list(bl.items))
assert not any(x[0] == led for x in found), found

notes: SP-xo45jvbj 2026-10-16: the three research stories shared only kb/public ledgers (_sources.csv, _anchors.csv, _gaps.md, _answers.md, expansions.csv), so held --overlaps ran them one after another; none conflicted at its rebase.
